items.title: Frank Foster — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: It so happened that Norman Granz’s Jazz at the Philharmonic was in town the same night.

ctx.x: Bad head and all. I was sicker then I had ever been in life, regurgitating all over the place all night long and all morning long. So the determination was that I had to make the trip, because I was the only one who could play lead alto and the music was all in my head. We rode in one of those old-fashioned buses that you open the windows. During the whole trip I kept my head out the window for two reasons, which are fairly obvious, one of which was to get fresh air. I won’t discuss the other one. On that trip I…
